ios.desc:
Download USGS topographic maps of the United States and use them offline, with no account and no subscription.

Topo Maps US is built for people who go where cell service doesn't: hikers, backpackers, hunters, anglers, paddlers, mountain bikers, geocachers, and anyone who wants a real topographic map in their pocket.

MAPS
Choose from three USGS map layers: standard topographic, aerial imagery with a topographic overlay, or plain aerial imagery.

OFFLINE
Tap the map squares you want and download them before you leave. Downloaded maps work with no Internet connection and use no cell data in the field.

TRAILS AND POINTS OF INTEREST BUILT IN
Every map download includes the trails, summits, lakes, campsites, and other named places in that area from OpenStreetMap, so you can search them by name while you're offline.

TRAIL RECORDING
Record where you go. Recorded trails show your path on the map with distance, elapsed time, and average speed. Recording stops automatically when you start driving, and any drive at the start or end of a trail is trimmed off.

ELEVATION PROFILES
Every recorded or imported trail gets an elevation profile with distance labels and color-coded grade shading. Drag along the chart to see the matching point on the map, its elevation, and the time you passed it.

FLAGS
Mark your current location or any spot on the map. Flags record coordinates and elevation, and you can add notes and organize them by color: geocaches, trailheads, summits, camps, and so on.

NAVIGATION
Pick a flag and follow the direction arrow, driven by your compass heading, with the distance remaining. Handy for geocaching and for finding your way back to camp or the car.

LOCATION
See where you are on the map, your elevation, speed, and the accuracy of the GPS fix.

MEASURE
Trace a route on the map to measure its distance, then save it as a trail to follow later.

IMPORT AND SHARE
Import trails and waypoints from GPX files and geocache LOC files. Share your flags and trails by email, Messages, or AirDrop as standard GPX files that work with any GPS unit or mapping software. Back up your maps and data to a computer over Wi-Fi.

Designed for iPhone and iPad.

Note: Continued use of GPS in the background can noticeably reduce battery life.

quotes.text:
Since people are mentioning the apps they like, for USA users, I can heartily recommend Topo Maps US (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/topo-maps-us/id1033846196) which is completely free and the work of a single developer.

It's fully offline and uses USGS Topo, Imagery, and Basic Imagery. The downside is that it takes a while to download the tiles (only once though) because you do download all the tiles for the area you select.

He also has a version for Canada, which I haven't tried.
quotes.story_title: Show HN: I made an offline-ready hiking trail companion app
